tagline: Take card payments with iyzico's hosted Checkout Form: redirect or a frame on your own page, results verified with iyzico's API before the order is invoiced, online refunds from credit memos and automatic handling of lost callbacks.
key_features: iyzico Checkout Form by redirect or in a frame on your page
Card details never reach your store (PCI SAQ A)
Results fetched from iyzico's API and checked before capture
Declined and abandoned payments: order cancelled, basket restored
Lost callbacks and fraud reviews finished by a cron job
Online full and partial refunds from credit memos
iyzico panel on the order and a transactions grid with CSV export
Luma and Hyvä, English and Turkish

benefits.title: Never trusts the browser
benefits.text: The store asks iyzico's API for the result and registers a payment only when the status, order number, currency, amount and response signature all match the order.

benefits.title: Customers keep their basket
benefits.text: When a card is declined, 3-D Secure fails or the customer comes back without paying, the order is cancelled, the basket restored and a clear message shown, so they can try again.

benefits.title: No order left behind
benefits.text: Every 5 minutes a cron job asks iyzico about orders still waiting: paid ones are invoiced, unpaid ones cancelled, payments still under way kept.

showcase.label: Checkout
showcase.title: Credit / Debit Card (iyzico)
showcase.text: The method shows the iyzico, Mastercard, Visa, American Express and Troy logo band and is offered only when the keys are set and the basket currency is one iyzico accepts.

showcase.label: Payment page
showcase.title: Redirect or on your own page
showcase.text: Send customers to iyzico's payment page, or show iyzico's form in a frame between your header and footer. 3-D Secure, installments and Pay with iyzico come with the form.

showcase.label: Order view
showcase.title: iyzico panel on every order
showcase.text: Status, payment ID, card, BIN, installments, amount charged, iyzico fees and refunds, with a Check Status at iyzico button for orders still waiting.

showcase.label: Transactions
showcase.title: Every payment form and its outcome
showcase.text: CommerceGears > iyzico > iyzico Transactions lists each payment form opened with order, payment ID, amounts, status, card and error code, with filters and CSV export.

showcase.label: Refunds
showcase.title: Refund from the credit memo
showcase.text: Full or partial online refunds, several in a row. A full refund on the day of payment uses iyzico's cancel, so nothing appears on the card statement.

feature_groups.title: Checkout
items: Redirect to iyzico's payment page (any theme) or iyzico's form in a frame (Luma and Hyvä)
Payment page language from the store view, or fixed Turkish or English
Installment counts can be limited, for example 1, 3 and 6
Currencies TRY, USD, EUR, GBP, NOK and CHF
Reopening the payment page reuses the open form instead of starting a second payment

feature_groups.title: Payment safety
items: Result checked against order number, currency, amount and response signature
Per-order lock: callback, webhook, cron and admin never invoice an order twice
A second or late payment for a paid or cancelled order is given back automatically
A waiting order cannot be cancelled while iyzico has a payment for it
Merchant notifications (webhook) with X-IYZ-SIGNATURE-V3 check, used only to ask iyzico again

feature_groups.title: After the payment
items: Invoice captured with the iyzico payment ID, order e-mail sent after payment
Fraud reviews held in Payment Review and finished when iyzico decides
Online refunds per basket item, installment charge refunded in proportion
Optional installment table on product pages for TRY prices

feature_groups.title: Admin and developers
items: Test Connection button and the notification URL in the settings
Keys stored encrypted, separate log file with personal data masked
REST endpoints that return the payment page URL for headless stores
Own ACL permissions for transactions, status checks and settings
